To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
stem application of neo-nictinoids is effective against aphid infestation in Virginia tobacco.
stem application of neo-nicotine insecticides was effective for management of tobacco aphid in Virginia tobacco and supported more natural enemy population.
stem application of insecticide can be used as a tool for the management of the aphid population and reduction in the leaf curl incidence in Virginia tobacco.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a stem application technology for the control of tobacco aphid,
the application of stem application of imidcloprid and thiamethaxm for the management of the tobacco Aphid, Myuzs nicotianae on FCV tobacco.
the development of an alternative method for management of aphid in Virginia tobacco.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
stem application of thiamethoxan @ 1:40 and imidaclopird @ 1: 30 dilutions are the most effective treatments for the management of the tobacco apid in FCV tobacco and can be used for the same.
stem application of imidalcoprid and thiamethaxom at recommended rates and dilution are effective in reducing the tobacco aphid population and improving the yield of FCV tobacco.
the stem application of neo-nictoinoids is a viable alternative to foliar application of insecticides in management of tobacco aphid in Virginia tobacco.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
stem application of neo-nicotine insecticides is an effective and environment friendly technique for management of the aphid and leaf curl disease complex in Virginia tobacco.
stem application of neo-nicitonoids was found as effective as foliar application in reducing the aphids on tobacco and also in supporting the natural enemies of aphids.
the stem application of neo-nicotine insecticides is a better option as it is effective, ecofriendly, cost effective and reduces the risk of aphids developing resistance to the insecticides.
The main takeaway from our work is that
stem application of neo-nicotine insecticides can be an effective alternative to foliar spray of insecticides for the management of tobacco aphid and other sucking pests in FCV tobacco.
stem application of insecticide can be an effective alternative to the foliar sprays of insecticides for the management of the tobacco pest complex.
stem application of insecticide is an effective tool for management of the aphid population in Virginia tobacco.
